verdict.rationale: Manufact's observability docs say the Gateway Requests tab shows every request flowing through the gateway, and an optional Capture payloads toggle stores full request and response bodies per event. That covers the core logging and gives the detail needed for auditing. However, replay is not documented, payload capture is opt-in rather than default, and there is no evidence on retention, export, or tool-call-specific filtering. missing for 10: documented replay of logged tool calls, retention/export of the audit log, payload capture on by default, and independent hands-on confirmation of log completeness.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see a log of every tool call that passed through the platform, with enough detail to audit or replay what an agent did

citations.quote: the Gateway Requests tab shows individual events: every request flowing through the gateway, refreshed every few seconds.
Toggle Capture payloads to also store full request and response bodies for each event
